title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, an unauthenticated user could use an empty…
description: Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 contain a vulnerability where an unauthenticated user can exploit an empty clustering shared secret to access and modify clustering configuration via the REST API on standalone instances. This flaw arises because the software accepts an empty shared secret as valid when clustering is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive configuration and disrupting cluster operations.
